facts.fact: An ASIN staff member's post says Benin's National Interoperability Platform (XROAD BJ), running since 2020, carries data between institutions' systems, as in a vehicle inspection fee query to the tax authority and road-safety agency.
The post gives XROAD BJ counters of 75 public and private members, 193 information systems integrated and 542 active services.
The post reports 205 million secure requests through XROAD BJ, 26.6 million in the last 30 days.

BEN.note: Document says nothing of ID at birth.
No law or decree on data sharing is stated.
Document does not say who builds or runs the platform beyond naming ASIN's team as builder, with no staffing statement.

facts.fact: The post says Benin is a pilot country for the Smart Africa Data Exchange (SADX) alongside Ghana and Rwanda.

BEN.note: Document says nothing of local civil registration offices.
Tax authority is only a queried source; no taxpayer register is described.
